verdict.rationale: Sierra Insights documents tracking agent performance against CSAT and case resolution, with reports whose data points can be drilled into via Explorer. That covers two of the four named metrics. Handoff rate appears only as an experimentation variable, not a reported metric, and cost per resolution is not evidenced. Outcome-based pricing is a billing model, not a dashboard. Missing for 10: documented handoff-rate metric, cost-per-resolution reporting, exec-ready dashboard detail, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, dashboards show resolution rate, CSAT, handoff rate, and cost per resolution — the numbers I report to my exec team

citations.quote: Track how your agent performs against your most critical metrics, like CSAT, case resolution, and more.
Click any data point on a report to launch Explorer and instantly investigate what's driving that trend.
